title: VERIFY T-491: the page loads nothing external and every label exists in both languages
acceptance_criteria: Read the page against design section 7, tab by tab. Mutants in a throwaway copy: add a key to es.json only; add a font link to another origin; drop the token header from one POST. Each must fail test_console_ui.py or be named as a gap. Verdict.

notes.note:
VERIFIED. Replay: test_console_ui.py + test_console.py = 33 passed. Page read against design section 7 tab by tab: Live (lanes, task cards, suite stat, wave chart, tooltips), Operator (decisions, review verdicts, gates, unsigned drafts as commands, close report, commit/push with diff stat), Society (names, warrants, acts, contracts count, cases, precedents, expandable details), Flows (list, form with tracks as rows, validate/save/launch with confirm, run history). ES/EN toggle, SSE, ?tab=/?lang=/#still present.
Mutants in throwaway copy ($D/repo): (a) key only in es.json: CAUGHT (same-keys and placeholder tests fail). (b) font stylesheet link to another origin in index.html: CAUGHT (test_index_loads_only_its_own_files). (c1) second fetch POST without token header: CAUGHT (test_writes_carry_the_token, fetch count). (c2) token header dropped inside send(): CAUGHT (same test).
GAPS (not blocking): (1) T-491 criterion 3, ?demo mode and ui/demo.json, is not built and not listed in design section 9; the server now exists so it is moot, but it is an unrecorded departure. (2) The static test checks fetch count and the header string, not that each POST carries the header at runtime; test_console.py covers the server side token refusal. (3) The test cannot check against section 7 content (tabs, tooltips); that was done by reading.
